_about: Mono 2: Mono as Ahmed hardened it (phantasic mini2-mono, Mono v5, 9 Oct 2026). Extends the fork's `mono` and leaves it untouched. What changes: the footage is grayscale and high contrast everywhere (brand.film and look.grade), slightly larger lead and tail lines, a dark scrim behind the words on footage pages (brand.footScrim), the icon pop sound pop-1, a music.fallback bed (lo-fi-02) when the licensed track is missing, a longer fade-out, and his -15 LUFS master recipe (written to build/master.json). The planner side (mono_plan.py, v5) emits the matching opt-in beat keys: punchOrigin (punch around the face), filmFace (frame the card / phone film on the face), fit (shrink a close-up over a blurred copy of itself), cardH / cardW (a portrait card for a close-up). Colour variants (mono-navy ...) still extend `mono`; extend `mono-2` for the hardened look in another colour.
